items.prompt: A render function does `const a = await fetchA(); const b = await fetchB();` where `fetchA` and `fetchB` don't depend on each other's results. What's wrong with this?

It's a waterfall: fetchB() isn't even called until fetchA()'s promise has already resolved, serializing two independent operations
fetchA and fetchB will run in a random order
This code will throw a runtime error
items.explanation: Sequential `await`s only start the second call after the first has resolved, even when the two calls don't need each other's data — turning parallelizable work into a serial chain.
items.reference:
await fetchA();
await fetchB(); // BAD: waterfall

await Promise.all([fetchA(), fetchB()]); // GOOD: parallel

Why: awaiting sequentially only starts the second call after the first resolves.
